name: Grand Sport Race

origin.basis: Continental's bicycle tires are marketed from its German site; Germany-made lines are marked 'Handmade in Germany'.

manufacturing.basis: Continental's size table gives no made-in statement for this line.

positioning: Budget all-rounder with a racing contour for tours and training.
weight_basis: Continental claims; a 345 g 25 mm version is also listed.
pressure_note: The product table does not list maximum pressures; use the figure printed on the tire.

availability.note: Continental's official Tmall store sells it in mainland China; Continental's German and US catalogs list it for retailers.

price_observations.market: Continental official Tmall store (德国马牌轮胎官方旗舰店)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing text does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair. Shipping within mainland China. A store coupon showed CNY 197.64.

caveats: Heavy for its width; owners on XHS describe it as an entry training tire that measures wide.

image.shown: Black Grand Sport Race as pictured on Continental's product page; one picture covers every width.
image.alt: Continental Grand Sport Race road tire with black sidewall

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-03 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list in a browser (the newest 15 per page when more exist; bundle pages that add inner tubes are not read), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Colour options on the same product page count as the same tire. Corrected on 2026-11-04: long reader comments are now read in full, not cut at 700 characters.

reports.summary: A courier riding about 15,000 km a year on latex tubes barely gets punctures, and those are mostly slow.

checks.note: No test page; one owner on the Ultra Sport III test
